title: Six feet
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Tuesday. Gully's. A line of tape on the floor, six feet from the counter. The strip draws the tape, exactly, and never says what it's for. Wood on the end stool, which is on the wrong side of the tape.

panels.composition: Gully's. A strip of blue tape across the floor. GULLY behind the counter. WOOD on the end stool — the stool on the far side of the tape from the counter. BARNABY II on the tape.

characters.pose: the end stool, beyond the tape

image.notes: The tape is never explained. Six feet. Reserved.

panels.composition: The tape. The dog's paw on it.

panels.composition: Gully sliding a coffee down the counter's length to the end. It stops at the edge. Wood reaching. Six feet.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man sliding a coffee the length of a counter to a thin man reaching for it from a stool set back from the counter

panels.composition: The two of them, the counter's length apart. The dog between, on the tape. The shop otherwise empty. Regular.
